dedupe_keys.name: the rinex dataset to the igs receiver antenna ring calibration campaign 2022 2024 igs ringcalval

description: Tobias Kersten at Leibniz University Hannover publishes raw RINEX observations for the IGS receiver-antenna ring calibration campaign. The Zenodo ZIP is free under CC BY 4.0. Measurements at the institute roof use stations MSD5 and MSD8, a common external clock and several individually calibrated antenna types during August 2022 and December 2023–January 2024. Reference coordinates and mounting offsets support positioning-validation simulations. The earlier draft data-igs-receiver-antenna-ring-calibration-campaign covers ANTEX calibration results at a different deposit, not these raw observations. Coverage is a controlled short-baseline experiment. The provider documents firmware-related loss of Galileo signals and a possible cold-weather cable problem, so observations need quality checks before pooling. Some installation dates and serial labels also differ between the table and narrative. No RINEX archive was downloaded or position solutions computed. These limitations do not remove the documented value for antenna and receiver calibration.
